main_text.head: MYSTERIUM DISSERTATIONIS DECIMÆ, QUA Hierarchiam, seu Clerum Ecclesiæ Romanæ dominantem Babylonem Magnam esse probatur Quintò, quia ejus Caput, Papa, se, ceu Numen Divinitatis particeps, religiosè coli patitur;
SECTIO PRIOR. QUA Papam Romanum, Hierarchiæ Caput, Divinitatem affectare, tum ex nomine Dei, tum ex octo Divinis attributis, quæ sibi vindicat, demonstratur.
BREVIARIUM.
main_text.p: I. Argumentum Quintum ab affectata à Papa Divinitate & religioso cultu petitum, & Syllogismo inclusum præponitur; ejusdemque propositio probatur.
II. Assumptionis demonstratio de capite Hierarchiæ Papa ipsam Hierarchiam ferit.
III. Numen particeps Divinitatis, seu Deum esse, tria significat, habere æternitatem &c. peccatori de ratione justitiæ & vitæ testari, & per testimonium illud fidem obligare;

page.notes: Running head is the title "MYSTERIUM" printed as page head; the page number 442 is printed top left. Heading level 1 for the dissertation title and level 2 for the section and Breviarium is a judgement. Some words in the Breviarium are in italic; the final line is right-aligned. Faint marks on the left edge are scan damage and were not transcribed.
